**Security: pass-with-notes** at `ef8cdd5f22b268a28aaabb2db6b9d587f4806566`.

No reportable security vulnerability in the 12-file delta: five added/seven modified, 515 additions/100 deletions.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| 0 | None | N/A | N/A | No reportable vulnerability | N/A |

Introduced source, rendered text and evidence contain no apparent private owner/name references, foreign-machine paths or secrets under C19/C21. The old private register was not accessed; historical private-source provenance is not certified under C15.

Removing all exemptions leaves the runtime guard fail-closed: nonempty proposed exemption JSON is rejected against the empty approved baseline, and inverse membership mismatches still fail. The repository test retains its empty-findings assertion, so zero-count equality cannot mask rejected data. Duplicate-identity and required-input guards are unchanged.

The 14 components/10 steps and s17 remain planned coverage, not shipped implementation. No new runtime authorization, read/write, skill or API-role change occurs. Passing coverage is not implementation proof.

**Proof:** exact-head CI [42399336669](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42399336669), attempt 1, passed all four jobs; Node 22/24 each executed 18 coverage-check tests. F104/C20 DD unavailability remains explicit, not full-schema validation. AC/role availability, current render/DD validation and claims-store checks remain reviewer-owned. No local tests/builds, DD execution, private-register/credential/store reads, live probes or product edits.
